autoBuyMaterialsNote.en: Auto-Buy is always active: missing upgrade materials are automatically purchased when supplies are sufficient.
autoBuyMaterialsNote.tl: Laging aktibo ang Auto-Buy: awtomatikong binibili ang mga kulang na materyales kapag sapat ang barya at gamit.

resetRealmConfirm.en: This will permanently erase your entire Realm progress, including buildings, minions, resources, upgrades, achievements, days, waves, and regression history. This cannot be undone. Continue?
resetRealmConfirm.tl: Ire-reset ang buong Realm at mabubura ang lahat ng progress, buildings, minions, resources, upgrades, achievements, days, waves, at regression history. Hindi na ito maibabalik. Ituloy?

importFailed.en: Failed to read the save file. Please select a valid IsoChronicle JSON export.
importFailed.tl: Hindi mabasa ang save file. Siguraduhing valid na IsoChronicle JSON file ito.

tenantsHint.en: Tenants spawn for free and look like the Champion; they are the units you see on the map.
tenantsHint.tl: Libreng lumilitaw ang mga umuupa at kamukha sila ng Kampeon; sila ang nakikita mo sa mapa.

enhanceDismiss.tl: Itago hanggang sa susunod na level

introContinueHint.en: Click or press Space to continue
introContinueHint.tl: I-click o pindutin ang Space para magpatuloy

introFullscreenError.en: Fullscreen is unavailable in this browser.
introFullscreenError.tl: Hindi suportado ang fullscreen sa browser na ito.

hubNothingReady.en: Nothing affordable yet. Gather or trade at the Market to unlock the next upgrade.
hubNothingReady.tl: Wala pang kayang bilhin. Mag-ipon o makipagkalakalan sa Pamilihan para sa susunod na upgrade.

hubGuideMinionsBody.en: Evolve the Slime and Treant, summon Generals, and assign work.
hubGuideMinionsBody.tl: I-evolve ang Slime at Treant, ipatawag ang mga Heneral, at magtalaga ng trabaho.

hubGuideSkillsBody.en: Spend points earned from waves on team-wide bonuses. Free to reset.
hubGuideSkillsBody.tl: Gastusin ang puntos mula sa mga alon sa bonus ng buong koponan. Libreng i-reset.

hubGuideResearchBody.en: Long-term upgrades for the Slime, Treant, citadel, establishments and tenants.
hubGuideResearchBody.tl: Pangmatagalang upgrade para sa Slime, Treant, kuta, pasilidad at umuupa.

hubGuideCastleBody.en: Walls, shield, beacon, and every establishment's tower and repairs.
hubGuideCastleBody.tl: Pader, kalasag, beacon, at tore at pagkukumpuni ng bawat pasilidad.

hubGuideForgeBody.en: Battle items, tower munitions, and equipment for your units.
hubGuideForgeBody.tl: Gamit sa labanan, bala ng tore, at kagamitan ng mga yunit.

hubGuideMarketBody.en: Trade coins for missing materials, or sell extras.
hubGuideMarketBody.tl: Ipagpalit ang barya sa kulang na materyales, o ibenta ang sobra.

estabResearchMoved.en: Establishment and tenant research now lives in Citadel Command, together with every other upgrade.
estabResearchMoved.tl: Nasa Citadel Command na ang pagsasaliksik ng pasilidad at umuupa, kasama ng lahat ng iba pang upgrade.

gfxStruggling.en: Running at {fps} FPS: try a lower preset for smoother play.
gfxStruggling.tl: {fps} FPS lang ang takbo: subukan ang mas mababang preset para mas smooth.

gfxShadowsHint.en: Ground shadows under units and buildings.
gfxShadowsHint.tl: Anino sa ilalim ng mga yunit at gusali.

gfxGlowHint.en: Additive glow halos and sparks on skill casts and hits.
gfxGlowHint.tl: Kumikinang na halo at kislap sa mga skill at tama.

musicPlayerDesc.en: Play your own YouTube or Spotify music while you play. Save as many playlists, albums, tracks or videos as you like and switch between them in the player. Your list is saved on this device on its own, apart from your realm progress: saving, exporting, importing or resetting the game never changes it (use the playlist export to move it).
musicPlayerDesc.tl: Patugtugin ang sarili mong musika mula sa YouTube o Spotify habang naglalaro. Mag-save ng kahit ilang playlist, album, kanta o video at magpalipat-lipat sa player. Hiwalay na naka-save ang listahan sa device na ito, hindi kasama ng progress ng realm: hindi ito nagbabago kapag nag-save, nag-export, nag-import o nag-reset ng laro (gamitin ang export ng playlist para ilipat ito).

musicPlayerPlaceholder.en: Paste a YouTube or Spotify link…
musicPlayerPlaceholder.tl: I-paste ang link ng YouTube o Spotify…

musicPlayerInvalid.en: That isn't a YouTube or Spotify link we can play.
musicPlayerInvalid.tl: Hindi iyan link ng YouTube o Spotify na kayang patugtugin.

musicPlayerNote.en: Needs an internet connection. The game's own music goes quiet while the player is open; sound effects keep playing. Spotify plays full tracks only when you're logged in to Spotify in this browser.
musicPlayerNote.tl: Kailangan ng internet. Tumatahimik ang sariling musika ng laro habang bukas ang player; tuloy pa rin ang sound effects. Buong kanta lang ang pinapatugtog ng Spotify kapag naka-login ka sa Spotify sa browser na ito.

musicPlayerOffline.en: You're offline. The music player needs an internet connection.
musicPlayerOffline.tl: Offline ka. Kailangan ng internet ng music player.

musicPlayerEmpty.en: No music set yet. Add a YouTube or Spotify link in Settings.
musicPlayerEmpty.tl: Wala pang nakatakdang musika. Maglagay ng link ng YouTube o Spotify sa Settings.

musicPlayerShuffle.tl: I-shuffle ang mga naka-save na link

musicPlayerFull.en: The list is full. Remove one first.
musicPlayerFull.tl: Puno na ang listahan. Magtanggal muna ng isa.

musicPlayerAutoPlay.en: Auto-play: starts on its own and moves to the next saved link
musicPlayerAutoPlay.tl: Auto-play: kusang tumutugtog at lumilipat sa susunod na naka-save na link

musicPlayerLoop.en: Auto-loop: repeats the list (or this link when auto-play is off)
musicPlayerLoop.tl: Auto-loop: inuulit ang listahan (o ang link na ito kapag naka-off ang auto-play)

musicPlayerFileDesc.en: Download your list to edit it in Excel / Sheets (.csv) or a docs app (.txt), then upload it back. Any line with a YouTube or Spotify link is added; the rest of the line becomes its name.
musicPlayerFileDesc.tl: I-download ang listahan para i-edit sa Excel / Sheets (.csv) o sa docs app (.txt), tapos i-upload ulit. Idinadagdag ang bawat linya na may link ng YouTube o Spotify; ang natitirang text sa linya ang magiging pangalan.

musicPlayerImportNone.en: No new YouTube or Spotify links found in that file.
musicPlayerImportNone.tl: Walang bagong link ng YouTube o Spotify sa file na iyon.

loadingStepCharacters.tl: Tinatawag ang mga alagad at manlulupig…

loadingTip1.en: Every establishment, the Crystal Spire included, has a General and five tenants.
loadingTip1.tl: Bawat pasilidad, kasama ang Crystal Spire, ay may isang General at limang umuupa.

loadingTip2.en: Expeditions through the rifts stir human vengeance: the next wave grows.
loadingTip2.tl: Ang mga ekspedisyon sa lagusan ay nagpapagalit sa mga tao: lumalaki ang susunod na alon.

loadingTip3.en: The Ent repairs what the invaders break once every General answers its call.
loadingTip3.tl: Inaayos ng Ent ang sinira ng mga manlulupig kapag sumagot na ang bawat General.

loadingTip4.en: Move an establishment between waves to reshape your defences.
loadingTip4.tl: Ilipat ang pasilidad sa pagitan ng mga alon para baguhin ang depensa.
